scope: bounded static implementation review; no model forward or optimizer replay

checks.fresh_communication_only: Each population member deep-copies one inherited v28 private-all checkpoint, excludes the private action head, and independently resets communication modules.
checks.same_world_bidirectional_batch: Both directions of each matched pair use the same 240-world, two-mask batch; independent token/action uniforms are allocated to the two directions.
checks.joint_round_payoff: The detached payoff gives .125 for each of four correct actions and an additional .5 only when all four actions in the pair are correct; the same advantage trains both directions.
checks.matched_partner_schedule: fixed_partners repeats (0,1),(2,3); rotating_partners alternates (0,1),(2,3) with (0,3),(2,1) on the same four-direction update budget.
checks.multi_partner_target: The target and training supports are disjoint 2-regular bipartite graphs with 12 edges; target evaluation requires both resource partners.
checks.condition_paired_fixtures: Both partner conditions use the same frozen world/photo/mask and uniform streams; only partner schedule changes.
checks.no_training_shortcut: All eight ordered cross-private-type protocol scores and offline structural references are computed from saved endpoint arrays.
checks.formal_gate: Formal execution binds production source hashes and inherited input hashes to preflight_qa.json.
checks.fixed_budget: All formal runs use 2400 population updates, 960 messages and 1920 resource actions per update, with no performance-based selection.

limitations: The four population members reuse two frozen private encoders; this tests a controlled partner schedule rather than natural demographic variation.
The joint payoff binds two directions of one matched pair to the same batch, but it is still a designed cooperation pressure and not a natural ecology.
The controlled task is a symbolic resource-location protocol, not a reconstruction of complete human ecology.
The bounded audit checks endpoint sender/receiver tables and selected categorical joint traces, but not every gradient or Adam transition.
The 199 complete-code relabelings are a descriptive structural reference and do not establish autonomous compositionality.
